name: Bajaj Finance Ltd
title: Bajaj Finance Ltd - 500034 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Bajaj Finance guides FY27 AUM growth 20-24%, credit cost 145-160 bps (down from 175 bps FY26 on new presentation), ROA 4.4-4.6%, ROE 19-20%, with no NIM expansion needed; MSME and captive 2W/3W drag winding down.

triggers.label: Credit cost FY27 145-160 bps
triggers.quote: we are entering the year on credit costs with tailwinds

triggers.label: MSME growth 6% to double-digit H2
triggers.quote: MSME should start to come back into some growth momentum to double -digit num ber from second half onwards

triggers.label: Opex to NTI improve 25-40 bps
triggers.quote: we expect to see continued improvement of 25 to 40 basis points from current levels

triggers.label: Captive 2W/3W attrition 60%
triggers.quote: the captive 2 -wheeler 3-wheeler financing business has seen an attrition of 60%

guidance.quote: we're confident of a 20% to 24% AUM growth
